## Summary

Describe what changed and why in plain language.

## What to review first

- List 1-3 files/areas where reviewers should focus.

## Collaboration checklist

- [ ] I asked Copilot for a review (local or PR) and addressed relevant feedback.
- [ ] A human teammate reviewed user impact and clarity (wording, UX, docs).
- [ ] A technical reviewer checked logic, maintainability, and edge cases.

## Quality, coverage, security, and cost checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior, or explained why tests were not needed.
- [ ] I verified happy path and edge cases manually when automated tests were not available.
- [ ] I checked for security impacts (input validation, auth, secrets, dependency risk).
- [ ] I avoided unnecessary complexity and duplicate work to keep implementation and review cost low.
- [ ] I documented any trade-offs and follow-up work.
